title: FLA import: text paragraph metrics skipped (leftMargin, rightMargin, indent, leading, letterSpacing)
description: In flash8-binary.ts readTextRunFields() around line 2072-2073, five text paragraph metrics are explicitly skipped: 'r.skip(8); // line spacing, indent, left margin, right margin' and 'if (ts >= 5) r.skip(2); // letter spacing'. The 8-byte skip covers 4 u16 fields: leading, indent, leftMargin, rightMargin (in some order). The 2-byte skip is letterSpacing (a u16 or s16). Fix: decode all five fields from the binary instead of skipping. Add them to Fla8TextRun interface. Forward through flash8-import.ts to the TextFormat/Paragraph model. In SWF encoding (packages/swf/src/text.ts), emit these via DefineEditText HasLayout flag (already used for align): the layout block contains LeftMargin, RightMargin, Indent, Leading as UI16 fields. Also check if letterSpacing maps to any SWF field. Verify field byte order against flacomdoc CPicText.
